nodes.description: Public total supply counter declared in the Token interface contract.
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 holding spending allowances.
Mapping address => uint256 with the BAT allocation entitled to each beneficiary after unlock.
Public timestamp before which no withdrawal is allowed.
Public address of the BAT ERC20 token contract used for payouts.
Constant 10**18 scaling factor applied to allocations before transfer.
Transfers _value tokens from msg.sender to _to, updating balances and emitting Transfer.
Transfers _value tokens from _from to _to using the caller allowance, updating balances and allowed.
Constant view returning the balance of _owner.
Sets the allowance that msg.sender grants to _spender.
Constant view returning the remaining allowance of _spender over _owner funds.
Constructor storing the BAT address, setting unlockDate from now and prefilling allocations.
External function that, after unlockDate, zeroes the caller allocation and transfers entitled*exponent BAT.
Caller address used as balance owner, allowance holder and allocation beneficiary.
Current block timestamp (now) used for unlockDate initialization and for the unlock gate.
Subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath; guarded only by a >= check exactly equal to the deducted amount.
Subtraction balances[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath inside transferFrom.
Subtraction allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath inside transferFrom.
Multiplication entitled * exponent performed without SafeMath; can overflow silently for large allocations.
External call StandardToken(BAT).transfer(msg.sender, entitled*exponent) that can revert on failure and reenter the withdraw flow.
Assignment unlockDate = now + 6*31 days depends on miner-controllable block.timestamp.
Destination address parameter of StandardToken.transfer.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transfer.
Source address parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom.
Address parameter whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Spender address parameter of StandardToken.approve.
Allowance amount parameter of StandardToken.approve.
Owner address parameter of StandardToken.allowance.
Spender address parameter of StandardToken.allowance.
BAT token address passed to the BATSafe constructor.
Local variable entitled holding allocations[msg.sender] cached before being zeroed in unlock.

edges.reason: The _to parameter flows into the balance update and Transfer event of transfer.
The _value parameter flows into the comparison, balance updates and event of transfer.
msg.sender determines whose balance is debited, so the caller identity controls the state change.
transfer writes the balances mapping for both msg.sender and _to.
transfer executes the unchecked balances[msg.sender] -= _value subtraction.
Untrusted _value is the operand of the unchecked subtraction on the sender balance.
The _from parameter is used to look up balances and the allowance in transferFrom.
The _to parameter receives the transferred amount in transferFrom.
The _value parameter drives all balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance holder whose spending rights authorize the transferFrom state change.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom writes the allowed mapping by decrementing the caller allowance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balances[_from] -= _value subtraction.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction.
Untrusted _value is the operand of the unchecked source balance subtraction.
Untrusted _value is the operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction.
The _owner parameter selects the balance returned by balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping to return the owner balance.
The _spender parameter identifies the allowance beneficiary in approve.
The _value parameter is the allowance amount stored by approve.
msg.sender is the owner granting the allowance, controlling the authorization state change.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
The _owner parameter selects the allowance owner read by allowance.
The _spender parameter selects the allowance spender read by allowance.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
The _BAT constructor argument is stored into the BAT state variable.
The BATSafe constructor writes the BAT address state variable.
block.timestamp (now) is read by the constructor to derive unlockDate, a timestamp dependency.
The BATSafe constructor writes unlockDate.
The BATSafe constructor prefills the allocations mapping for the listed beneficiaries.
The constructor performs the timestamp-dependent unlockDate = now + 6*31 days computation.
Miner-controllable block.timestamp is the input of the unsafe unlockDate computation.
msg.sender selects the caller allocation that unlock reads and zeroes.
unlock compares now against unlockDate, making the withdrawal gate timestamp dependent.
unlock reads the unlockDate state variable in its guard condition.
unlock reads and then zeroes the allocations mapping entry of msg.sender.
unlock caches allocations[msg.sender] into the local variable entitled.
Local entitled is the multiplicand of the unchecked entitled * exponent scaling.
unlock performs the unchecked entitled * exponent multiplication before transferring.
The exponent constant 10**18 is the multiplier of the unchecked scaling multiplication.
The BAT address is the target contract of the external transfer call.
unlock triggers the external StandardToken(BAT).transfer call, the classic reentrancy entry point.
The external BAT transfer callback can re-enter unlock, though allocations[msg.sender] is zeroed first.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter of transfer has no independent semantics and is merged into the transfer function node.
The _value parameter of transfer only exists to feed the transfer function's arithmetic and is merged into it.
The _from parameter of transferFrom is a temporary alias of the source balance and is merged into transferFrom.
The _to parameter of transferFrom is a temporary alias of the destination balance and is merged into transferFrom.
The _value parameter of transferFrom is a temporary alias of the amount and is merged into transferFrom.
The _owner parameter of balanceOf is only a lookup key and is merged into balanceOf.
The _spender parameter of approve is only an allowance index and is merged into approve.
The _value parameter of approve is only the stored allowance and is merged into approve.
The _owner parameter of allowance is only a lookup key and is merged into allowance.
The _spender parameter of allowance is only a lookup key and is merged into allowance.
The _BAT constructor argument is immediately stored into the BAT state variable and is merged into the BATSafe constructor.
The entitled local variable is a short-lived cache of allocations[msg.sender] and is merged into the unlock function.
